title: Mint Pear Drop Earrings
descriptionHtml:
Three small lights, then one of mint. From the stud, a short curved line of three small clear pear-cut stones leads down to one larger pear in pale mint green, every stone held in fine gold claws. About 22mm long, it falls just below the lobe.

STYLING TIP: Wear them with hair tucked back and a white or ivory neckline so the mint reads.

Details

  • Length: Approximately 22mm
  • Stones: Three small clear pear cut cubic zirconia leading to one pale mint green pear, approximately 9mm
  • Setting: Fine gold claws
  • Closure: Post with butterfly back
  • Plating: 18k gold tone plated
  • Material: Surgical stainless steel

Care

Waterproof and tarnish free, so daily wear and water are fine. Keep it away from perfume and harsh chemicals, wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.
